hook.name: FlowPadCurveHook
hook.description: FlowPad bonding-curve launch hook. Seeds a pool with single-sided concentrated token liquidity; buyers walk the price down accumulating ETH, functioning as a real on-chain bonding curve. Enforces a configurable snipe guard (first N blocks restricted to the launcher), takes ETH-denominated trade fees split between creator and protocol via BeforeSwapDelta/AfterSwapDelta, and supports permissionless graduation once the curve sells out.
